# EMNIST FPGA Cloud SDK Result Logs

This file consolidates the complete accepted EMNIST Balanced FPGA-to-Google Cloud Run SDK/UART measurement series, following the format of **MNIST FPGA Cloud SDK Result Logs**. Measurements were recorded on November 18, 2026.

## Notes on provenance

- Each of the ten 100-image blocks (0–99 through 900–999) has **one separate cold-start validation** and **three formal runs**: 40 complete 100-image logs, containing 4,000 per-image records in total.
- Only the **30 formal runs (3,000 requests)** contribute to the formal accuracy, latency, and throughput results; the ten cold-start validation runs are reported separately.
- EMNIST Balanced has 47 class IDs (0–46). The `index` field in original SDK CSV output is **local to each 100-image block** (0–99); global dataset index = block start + local index.
- The per-image `latency_us` is SDK-measured request latency, **not** isolated Cloud Run model inference time. Run throughput is 100 divided by the full application-reported run duration.
- Every included run contains local indices 0–99, a completion marker, and zero reported communications errors. Additional interrupted TCP error 13 observations outside accepted runs are not counted as completed formal requests.
- All 14–16 classification errors in a block were repeated exactly across that block’s cold-start validation and three formal runs (same image and predicted class). Repeated requests do not represent independent distinct images.
- TLSv1.2 connections used `TLS-ECDHE-ECDSA-WITH-AES-128-GCM-SHA256`, but certificate verification and secure entropy were **not enabled** in this development build; connection success is not proof of authenticated server identity.
- The individual CSV records below are transcribed from the original uploaded logs without imputing any missing values. Latency outliers remain included in all reported formal statistics.

## Scope and limitations

- This archive documents the ZedBoard cloud-assisted EMNIST 100-image controlled batches only; it does not contain local-only inference tests, Unity/Quest measurements, server-only Cloud Run timing, measured power, or FPGA resource utilization.
- The complete series included 10 cold-start validations and 30 formal runs, with 4,000 total SDK image requests; only 3,000 are formal.
- Acceptance of completed runs with zero application-reported communication errors must not be interpreted as proof that all connection attempts were reliable, given separately observed interrupted TCP error 13 events.
- In the development TLS configuration, server certificate verification and secure entropy were disabled. No security attack tests are represented by these logs.
